title: Establish per-GPU performance profile matrix and onboarding for model versions
creator: Priya Nair
description: Background and purpose: We need canonical, hardware-specific performance profiles for A100/H100/L40S/MI300 SKUs to support model onboarding, version pinning, and publishing to the model catalog. These profiles must capture recommended runtime config (batch sizes, quantization, kernel hints), expected throughput/latency envelopes, and compatibility matrix against model versions so that serving and routing layers can choose optimal model variants at runtime. This ticket owns the benchmark harness, schema for profile entries, validation tests, and initial profiles for 4 representative models (m-1, m-2, m-3-quant, m-4-large).
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark harness can execute standardized runs on A100/H100/L40S/MI300 with reproducible outputs
Schema defined and merged to model-catalog:hardware_profiles and fields validated by CI
Published profiles (A100/H100/L40S/MI300) for 4 models with p50/p95/p99 latency and tokens/sec at recommended configs
Model version pinning rules documented: stable pin, minor-compatible, fallback chains; wired into routing layer tests
Automated validation job runs nightly and fails on >15% regression vs baseline for p95 latency or tokens/sec
